scope: scripts/qualify_diagnostic_experiments_offline.py (57 MCP checks) and scripts/qualify_repeated_diagnostic_experiments_offline.py (78 MCP checks) on the Release Host with samples from tests/TiaMcp.Diagnostics.Tests: experiment planning from exact saved cases, review with original-evidence and replan-lineage revalidation, 2..8 before/after pair comparison with explicit mappings and windows, JSON/Markdown/escaped HTML report export after rederivation, and stale/tampered input refusals.
limitations: Host-only: native engineering and simulator workers are deliberately absent; no TIA Portal, Openness, PLCSIM, OPC UA server or device is involved and none is qualified.
Synthetic measurements only; no native or runtime acquisition (diagnostic_experiment_acquire_runtime and diagnostic_runtime_acquisition_export are not covered), causal diagnosis or fix proof.
